The "inventory" action is admissible and will help determine the current state of my possession, which is essential before proceeding to any physical location.

- If I don’t have it, I will need to search through the drawers, shelves, or dresser to find it.

Since I don’t currently have any information about the cellphone’s location, the best first action is to check my inventory.
